behavior: Portable startup owns data, config, caches, logs and passphrase-protected keys without using the installed profile.
scope: D1/E15 development acceptance only. Next changes remain separate from v3.0 core source cut 4b96e802. Installed qualification remains R1.

requirements.profile_isolation: Explicit pre-desktop selection, exclusive private root, portable data/config/cache/model/pack paths, process-output logs and incognito WebViews with an absolute profile-owned browser directory.
requirements.key_and_credentials: Memory-only portable key and passphrase-wrapped credential vault. Production-path subprocess test preserves saved settings, search history and credentials after relocation without host key storage.
requirements.refusal: Wrong-key attempts preserve durable profile bytes; malformed markers, external links, foreign recovery identities, missing-primary existing settings and dangling settings links fail closed.
requirements.recovery: Stable identity has one durable versioned marker owner. Interrupted marker publication, lost locks, contained hardlinks, corrupt/missing primary data, and interrupted receipt/journal migration are covered.
requirements.relocation: Authenticated canonical startup rebinds older update receipts and journals without rewriting snapshot data. Successful startup followed by relocation and corrupt-primary recovery passes.
requirements.resume_references: Managed application and HTML-review resume references survive relocation; unrelated external paths are not redirected by basename.
requirements.unlock_ui: Failed or malformed post-unlock status reads retry status rather than unlock again; pending secret entry is cleared and late responses cannot open a replacement gate.
